title: Bloodshift
finalEditPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit the supplied BLOODSHIFT capsule to look MUCH LESS REALISTIC and MUCH LESS VISUALLY NOISY. The user wants a clean, stylized, hand-drawn cartoon game illustration, closer to bold indie fantasy animation key art.

Make a substantial simplification of the actual drawing:
- Bold, clean, slightly organic black outlines with controlled line weight.
- Flat matte color fills with ONE clear cel-shadow shape and at most one small highlight per major form. No realistic rendering or intricate lighting.
- Simplified expressive adult cartoon faces, clear graphic eyes and eyebrows, noses suggested with a couple of lines. Keep both faces recognizable and serious; not chibi.
- Hair drawn as a few large confident spikes/locks, not dozens of fine strands. White fur drawn as a handful of large soft tufts.
- Armor reduced to simple strong red/gold and purple/gold shapes. Remove tiny engravings, scratches, rivets and filigree. Keep the distinctive shoulder armor silhouettes.
- Clothing uses broad red, violet and charcoal panels with only a few meaningful folds. Simplify ropes and floral motifs drastically.
- The background must be quiet: three or four flat layered silhouettes of the shrine, torii, mountains and trees, with broad smooth teal mist bands. Remove dense foliage, masonry detail, tiny buildings, hatching and hundreds of sharp marks. Preserve the general moonlit shrine setting and a couple of understated demon silhouettes.
- Moon becomes a simple warm ivory circle with at most two broad flat patches, no lunar texture.
- Keep only a few clearly shaped red leaves.
- Remove ALL scratchy paint texture, stippling, dry-brush noise, canvas grain, paper grain, crosshatching, speckles, grunge, mottling and tiny highlights. This must look deliberately redrawn in a cleaner cartoon style, not blurred, denoised, or covered by a filter. Clean spacious color shapes and readable silhouettes.

Preserve the current composition: the red Samurai on the left and purple Ninja on the right, their exact poses and visible closed fists, face directions, costume identity, fur collar, flame chest mark, ponytail and scarf, and the large title along the bottom. Both remain unarmed. Preserve correct hand anatomy; don't open the fists or add fingers.

Preserve the exact BLOODSHIFT lettering style, letter shapes, spelling, proportions, bottom-center placement and ivory color. Clean the grain from inside the letters for a smoother ivory fill, but do not change the font. The black backing behind the logo should be a simple, quiet dark shape rather than a scratched painted surface.

Palette: restricted deep teal, near-black, crimson, violet, warm skin tones, ivory, and a little flat antique gold. Maintain the dark fantasy mood while increasing separation between the simplified heroes and subdued background.
No photorealism, no glossy 3D, no painterly detail, no gradients across skin, no surface noise, no weapons, no new characters, no extra text. Preserve wide landscape framing.
